summary: PulseGuard v0.6.7 is the final optimizer-accuracy polish: live FIX + OPTIMIZE state, settled CPU evidence, truthful verification wording, and a prominent completion summary.

sections.heading: Real optimizer progress
sections.detail: The Optimize page now exposes the real major FIX + OPTIMIZE operations—safety preflight, baseline CPU, restore point, Deep Clean, Registry Review, Privacy Sweep, performance setup, startup, Windows repair, drivers/apps, security, device rescan, Game Ready, and final verification. The currently executing operation always owns the RUNNING state.

sections.heading: Truthful repair state
sections.detail: Changes recorded during the active workflow show Verification pending until targeted verification finishes. UNVERIFIED is reserved for the final state when PulseGuard cannot prove the individual repair.

sections.heading: Settled CPU comparison
sections.detail: Before and after background CPU now use matching median multi-sample measurements after a settle period. A higher post-optimization result is shown as elevated/recheck recommended, not green improvement.

sections.heading: Prominent completion summary
sections.detail: The tiny top Completed in timer is hidden after completion. The bottom result area is anchored to the bottom of the window and prominently shows OPTIMIZATION COMPLETE plus the elapsed time and repair-proof summary.

sections.heading: Hardware Health unchanged
sections.detail: The v0.6.6 evidence-based Hardware Health Check and its scoring logic are unchanged in this optimizer-only release.
